messages:
Jordan Park: Handoff: Veridian Labs closed today. Passing to CS for onboarding + to Eng for private deployment + SAML. Sales notes attached in CRM.

Jordan Park: Quick highlights:
```
account: Veridian Labs (Enterprise)
primary: rachel@veridian.com (VP of Platform)
eng reqs: private VPC, SAML (Okta), dedicated capacity (2x A100 equiv), audit logging
expected qps: 120 steady, 600 burst
SLO: p95 < 200ms for gen endpoints
contract: 1yr + optional renewal ramp after GA
```

Lina Gomez: Thanks Jordan 1. I'll take CS lead for onboarding.
Lina Gomez: Need these from Sales before kickoff: IdP metadata, network CIDR for peering, and the list of IPs for allowlist. Also any compliance questionnaires (SOC2/ISO) they completed.

Carlos Rivera: @support-bot please open ENG ticket for private deploy + SSO. Include perf sizing and network tasks.

support-bot: Created ENG-8122: "Veridian private deploy + SAML setup". Owners: eng-runtime + eng-network. Priority: high. Link: https://internal/ENG-8122

Maya Chen: I'll prepare the CS runbook and support playbook. Proposed owners:
- CS lead: Lina Gomez (kickoff, enablement)
- Technical eng owner: Carlos Rivera (SSO, VPC peering)
- CS enablement docs: Maya Chen (runbook, support playbook)

Lina Gomez: Immediate checkpoints & timelines:
- Sales to provide IdP metadata & network info 1: due 2024-04-04
- CS kickoff meeting 1: target 2024-04-07
- ENG initial sizing + perf PR in ENG-8122 1: due 2024-04-14
- SSO + peering config applied in staging 1: due 2024-04-28
- Pilot traffic verification 1: target 2024-05-12

Jordan Park: Note from sales: customer wants a short pilot (2 weeks) before GA. They requested a dedicated contact for security approvals. Rachel will be the approver.

Carlos Rivera: I'll need model details: family, max tokens, typical prompt/response size, concurrency target. Also whether KV caching/prefix caching is acceptable for them. Lina, can you capture that in kickoff?

Maya Chen: I'll include a small troubleshooting matrix in the support playbook (SSO failures, network timeouts, quota errors). Also adding post-kickoff feedback survey for the customer's engineering team.

Lina Gomez: Risk assessment: Renewal risk = low (contracted). Execution risk = medium-high until peering + SSO done. If network approvals delay > 2 weeks past kickoff we should escalate to Sales lead Jordan.

Jordan Park: Agree. I'll spotlight in CRM and flag the AM to follow up on approvals. Weekly sync until SSO verified sounds good.

Maya Chen: CS -> Support handoff plan: after pilot verification, we will do a 1-hour enablement + walkthrough, transfer runbook link, list of errors to watch, and a Jira template for triage. Target handoff doc by 2024-05-20.

support-bot: ENG-8122 updated with owners and initial checklist.

Lina Gomez: Next steps (summary):
1) Sales (Jordan) provide IdP + network info by 4/04
2) Lina schedule kickoff for 4/07 and post agenda here
3) Carlos post sizing details to ENG-8122 by 4/14
4) Maya draft runbook + support playbook and share draft by 5/10

Jordan Park: Intro email to Rachel and security lead sent, cc Lina + Maya + Carlos. Rachel replied: "we'll start internal approvals this week."

Lina Gomez: I'll update the customer-success tracker and reopen this thread with the kickoff invite. Ping me here for blockers. :handshake:

Maya Chen: I'll attach a sample post-kickoff feedback form to ENG-8122 once it's live.

Carlos Rivera: Will spin up a small staging pool for perf tests once sample payloads are in ENG-8122.

Lina Gomez: Closing this thread for now 1 will post kickoff invite shortly.
